audit_items.proof_trace: Both non-liquidation valuation functions (`debts_value_usd_non_liquidation` at L1198 and `collaterals_usd_non_liquidation` at L1284) call `get_price_with_check`, which asserts `abs(ema-spot)/spot <= tolerance` and always returns the EMA price. Both `handle_borrow` (L424) and `handle_withdraw` (L332) unconditionally call `is_obligation_safe`, which invokes these functions, so no borrow or withdraw can proceed if the deviation check fails. Liquidation paths intentionally use plain `get_price` (by design, to allow liquidations during volatile markets), which is outside this property's scope.
